description: An opaque dark teal floor-length coat-dress has a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, and gold-toned woven borders and stylized animal and curling motifs on the skirt. A cream underdress and long cream shawl with matching borders are visible at the center and along the arms. A broad decorated sash with a round ornamental clasp and several hanging pendants secures the waist. Brown embroidered boots are visible below the hem.
